description: Proposes keeping one of Cairn's live tools - the Retirement Planner, Mortgage Overpayment or Career Break Cost - on the person's Tools page in Foliopeak, under Kept From Cairn, with the figures its sliders are on, so it opens again in the matching calculator. Use when they say 'keep this', 'save this tool'. It is kept only when they approve it in Foliopeak, so nothing changes until they approve it there.

inputs.description: The figures it was on: retirement - retireAge, monthlyIn, spending; mortgage - overpayment, ratePct, years; career_break - monthsOff, pensionMonthly, takeHome, yearsToRetirement. The `inputs` in the tool's structuredContent.

tool.description: Which tool: the `tool` in its structuredContent.

name: keep_tool
title: Keep a live tool
